hebrewText: הֵ֣ן יִשָּׂא אִ֨ישׁ בְּשַׂר קֹ֜דֶשׁ בִּ/כְנַ֣ף בִּגְד֗/וֹ וְ/נָגַ֣ע בִּ֠/כְנָפ/וֹ אֶל הַ/לֶּ֨חֶם וְ/אֶל הַ/נָּזִ֜יד וְ/אֶל הַ/יַּ֧יִן וְ/אֶל שֶׁ֛מֶן וְ/אֶל כָּל מַאֲכָ֖ל הֲ/יִקְדָּ֑שׁ וַ/יַּעֲנ֧וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹֽא

tokens.bdb: lo!; also (as expressing surprise) if
tokens.kjv: behold, if, lo, though.

tokens.bdb: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
tokens.kjv: accept, advance, arise, (able to, (armor), suffer to) bear(-er, up), bring (forth), burn, carry (away), cast, contain, desire, ease, exact, exalt (self), extol, fetch, forgive, furnish, further, give, go on, help, high, hold up, honorable ([phrase] man), lade, lay, lift (self) up, lofty, marry, magnify, [idiom] needs, obtain, pardon, raise (up), receive, regard, respect, set (up), spare, stir up, [phrase] swear, take (away, up), [idiom] utterly, wear, yield.

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).

tokens.bdb: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman
tokens.kjv: body, (fat, lean) flesh(-ed), kin, (man-) kind, [phrase] nakedness, self, skin.

tokens.bdb: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
tokens.kjv: consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, ([idiom] most) holy ([idiom] day, portion, thing), saint, sanctuary.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanation: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanationEn: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract

tokens.bdb: an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle
tokens.kjv: [phrase] bird, border, corner, end, feather(-ed), [idiom] flying, [phrase] (one an-) other, overspreading, [idiom] quarters, skirt, [idiom] sort, uttermost part, wing(-ed).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: an edge or extremity; specifically  a wing
tokens.enLiteralWord: an edge or extremity; specifically  a wing
tokens.explanation: an edge or extremity; specifically  a wing

tokens.bdb: a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage
tokens.kjv: apparel, cloth(-es, ing), garment, lap, rag, raiment, robe, [idiom] very (treacherously), vesture, wardrobe.

tokens.bdb: properly, to touch, i.e. lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphemistically, to lie with a woman); by implication, to reach (figuratively, to arrive, acquire); violently, to strike (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.)
tokens.kjv: beat, ([idiom] be able to) bring (down), cast, come (nigh), draw near (nigh), get up, happen, join, near, plague, reach (up), smite, strike, touch.

tokens.bdb: an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle
tokens.kjv: [phrase] bird, border, corner, end, feather(-ed), [idiom] flying, [phrase] (one an-) other, overspreading, [idiom] quarters, skirt, [idiom] sort, uttermost part, wing(-ed).

tokens.bdb: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)
tokens.kjv: (shew-) bread, [idiom] eat, food, fruit, loaf, meat, victuals.

tokens.kjv: pottage.

tokens.bdb: wine (as fermented); by implication, intoxication
tokens.kjv: banqueting, wine, wine(-bibber).

tokens.kjv: anointing, [idiom] fat (things), [idiom] fruitful, oil(-ed), ointment, olive, [phrase] pine.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: an eatable (includ. provender, flesh and fruit)
tokens.kjv: food, fruit, (bake-)meat(-s), victual.

tokens.bdb: to be (causatively, make, pronounce or observe as) clean (ceremonially or morally)
tokens.kjv: appoint, bid, consecrate, dedicate, defile, hallow, (be, keep) holy(-er, place), keep, prepare, proclaim, purify, sanctify(-ied one, self), [idiom] wholly.

tokens.bdb: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
tokens.kjv: give account, afflict (by mistake for H6031 (עָנָה)), (cause to, give) answer, bring low (by mistake for H6031 (עָנָה)), cry, hear, Leannoth, lift up, say, [idiom] scholar, (give a) shout, sing (together by course), speak, testify, utter, (bear) witness. See also H1042 (בֵּית עֲנוֹת), H1043 (בֵּית עֲנָת).

tokens.bdb: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
tokens.kjv: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

tokens.bdb: to say (used with great latitude)
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
